description.short: BSA Scout fundraising app - exclusive merchant discounts & offers
description.full:
Camp Card is the official BSA (Boy Scouts of America) digital discount subscription app that makes fundraising easier and more rewarding for Scouts, families, and communities.

FEATURES:
• Browse exclusive merchant offers and discounts
• Scan QR codes for instant offer redemptions
• Track your fundraising progress
• Support your local Scout troop with every purchase
• Find participating merchants near you
• Manage your subscription and account

FOR SCOUTS & FAMILIES:
Access hundreds of local and national discounts from participating merchants. Every redemption supports Scout programs and activities.

FOR TROOP LEADERS:
Track your troop's fundraising progress, manage Scout accounts, and see redemption analytics all in one place.

FOR MERCHANTS:
Partner with Camp Card to reach engaged Scout families and support youth development in your community.

Download Camp Card today and start saving while supporting Scouts!

releaseNotes.notes:
Version 1.1.0:

• App Tracking Transparency (ATT) framework integration
• Enhanced subscription disclosure before purchases
• Improved first-party analytics (no third-party tracking)
• Updated Privacy Policy with ATT section
• Reduced Android permissions to minimum required
• Bug fixes and performance improvements

reviewInformation.notes:
Demo Account:
Email: demo@campcard.org
Password: Password123
Role: PARENT (has active subscription, full feature access)

ATT (App Tracking Transparency):
The ATT permission prompt appears on first launch (iOS only) before any analytics tracking begins. The app uses first-party analytics only (no third-party analytics SDKs). If the user denies tracking, no IDFA is accessed. Implementation: App.tsx calls useTrackingPermission() hook.

In-App Purchases:
The app uses StoreKit 2 via expo-iap. Products:
- org.bsa.campcard.subscription.annual (auto-renewable, $14.99/year)
- org.bsa.campcard.cards.1 through .cards.10 (consumable card packs)

Subscription Disclosure (Guideline 3.1.2):
Before every subscription purchase, a SubscriptionDisclosureModal shows: subscription name, duration, price, auto-renewal terms, Privacy Policy link, Terms of Use link. Displayed BEFORE the native StoreKit payment sheet.

iPad Support:
Runs in portrait mode with responsive layouts. iPad screenshots are genuine iPad Simulator captures (2048x2732).

Privacy:
- No Firebase Analytics or Crashlytics
- First-party analytics only
- Privacy Policy: https://www.campcardapp.org/privacy
- Terms of Use: https://www.campcardapp.org/terms

appActivity.note: First-party analytics only, not shared with third parties
